note: A screen, not an audit: questions worth asking and the data needed to answer them. No savings are computed; typical benefits are the cited sources' general wording.

questions.question: Could a condensing economizer serve a cold makeup or process-water heating load?

equipment W-A reads "W-A MAKEUP WATER load"

questions.decision_rule: Worth a quote when a steady cold water load exists near the stack.
